articles.title: DH Speak Out | November 2, 2026
Could Einstein’s equations explain the universe’s expansion?
articles.description: Researchers from UC Davis have proposed that dark energy may not be necessary to explain the universe's acceleration. They found weak points in the Lambda-cold dark matter model using Einstein's equations. By examining instabilities in Friedmann spacetimes, they suggest alternative explanations for cosmic expansion. Their work raises questions about the Copernican principle in the context of current models. This research could lead to significant shifts in our understanding of cosmology.

Narayan's 'The Ramayana' and other themed collectables. Early box office estimates reveal that 'Ramayana' has generated around USD 3.86 million in overseas advance bookings. The film is expected to perform well during the upcoming festive period in India.

articles.title: From children's hospitals to community causes: Josh Allen and Hailee Steinfeld's millions in charity-linked support
articles.description: Josh Allen and Hailee Steinfeld have been linked to several charitable initiatives supporting children and families. Their efforts include Allen's personal donations and hospital pledges, fundraising campaigns, and Steinfeld's charity partnership. While the combined charity-linked contributions and fundraising mentioned reach approximately $2.39 million, much of that amount came from organisations and public campaigns rather than the couple's personal donations.

articles.title: Janhvi Kapoor recreates Sridevi's iconic Naagin look, Priyanka Chopra channels King Kylie: How Bollywood celebs celebrated Halloween 2026
articles.description: Bollywood celebrities celebrated Halloween 2026 by dressing in various creative costumes and sharing their looks online. Janhvi Kapoor honored her mother Sridevi by recreating her iconic Naagin look from a classic film. Priyanka Chopra and her family each chose unique costumes. Scroll down and take a look!
